title: Video by promptwarrior
description:
How to set up Telegram groups in OpenClaw:
1. Tell your openclaw to set up groups
2. set requireMention to false
3. set dmPolicy to ‘allowlist’ and your telegram id to ‘alllowFrom’ as well as allowFromGroup”
4. bot privacy mode off and add your bot as admin in the group (forgot to mention this one in the video)

Let me know if that worked for you
